patch.value:
pm-cli now uses pm-changelog for the main CHANGELOG.md. The generated current-release section uses headings like `## 2026.5.24 - 2026-05-24`, while the existing released changelog follows Keep a Changelog style headings like `## [2026.5.24] - 2026-05-24` and includes older release sections.

When pm-cli switches from destructive `--mode replace` to the safer package-owned `--mode prepend`, pm-changelog fails to identify those headings as the same release. It inserts a duplicate current-release section instead of replacing the existing section, so projects cannot preserve real release history while regenerating the current release from pm items.

Expected behavior:
- `mergeChangelog` / `--mode prepend` should treat bracketed Keep a Changelog headings as equivalent to unbracketed generated headings for the same version.
- Example: generated `## 2026.5.24 - 2026-05-24` should replace existing `## [2026.5.24] - 2026-05-24`.
- Older release sections and top-of-file prose should be preserved.

This is needed so pm-cli can rely on pm-changelog without custom scripts or hand-written changelog repair.
